clips.title: The story
paras: In Ban'ethil Barrow Den, Gnarlpine shamans wield the Shaman Voodoo Charm. Its vile magic can sever a sleeping druid's spirit from the body.

The Gnarlpine tribe has fallen into madness and corruption on Teldrassil. Within Ban'ethil Barrow Den, its shamans wield magic beyond ordinary wilderness sorcery. Their voodoo charms let them tear a sleeping druid's consciousness from the mortal realm and trap it in the Emerald Dream. The furbolgs then animate the empty body. Night elf protectors become mindless guardians, killing anyone who enters the barrows.
